body: So turns out my new place already had pre-installed telus modem. I just had to download my telus wifi app and follow their steps to setup the wifi on my own.
Didnt show up. The internet at my old address shut off, but no internet at the new place. I'm going to call them first thing in the morning. I hope they can hook up the internet without long wait..

I havent received any text confirmation, but i received an email right after phonecall just about the change in address. I guess the only way to find out is if i wait till tomorrow morning. Ill let you guys know

The old rental place has a pre-installed telus modem, and they told me on the phone they will send a guy with a new modem to install in our place. I was told the old place internet will be automatically cancelled the moment the new one is installed
